check_sql:
WITH saved AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT value c FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_event e CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(e.details->'correction_rows') WHERE e.event_id=104400),
checks AS(SELECT c,r.record_sha256 identity_sha,r.point_date,r.content#>>'{source_record,ticker}' identity_ticker,r.content#>>'{source_record,cik}' identity_cik,o.record_sha256 source_sha,o.normalization_sha256,o.effective_date,o.values_json->>'symbol' source_symbol,o.source_published_at,o.historical_received_at,o.available_at
FROM saved LEFT JOIN population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.ref01_date_record_v4 r ON r.source_id=c->>'identity_source_id' AND r.ordinal=(c->>'identity_source_ordinal')::int
LEFT JOIN population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.source_observation o ON o.family_id='S01' AND o.source_id=c#>>'{records,0,source_id}' AND o.source_record_key=c#>>'{records,0,source_record_key}')
SELECT count(*) rows_checked,count(*) FILTER(WHERE identity_sha IS DISTINCT FROM c->>'identity_record_sha256' OR point_date IS DISTINCT FROM (c->>'session_date')::date OR identity_ticker IS DISTINCT FROM c->>'ticker' OR 'CIK:'||identity_cik IS DISTINCT FROM c->>'company_id') identity_errors,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE source_sha IS DISTINCT FROM c#>>'{records,0,record_sha256}' OR normalization_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM c#>>'{records,0,normalization_sha256}' OR effective_date IS DISTINCT FROM (c->>'session_date')::date OR source_symbol IS DISTINCT FROM c->>'ticker') source_link_errors,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE source_published_at IS NOT NULL OR historical_received_at IS NOT NULL) unexpected_temporal_claims,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE available_at>='2026-10-01') later_ingestion_only,
count(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT((c->>'ticker'='ADIG' AND (c->>'session_date')::date BETWEEN '2026-08-04' AND '2026-09-30' AND c->>'qualification_event_id'='84653') OR(c->>'ticker'='VMRK' AND c->>'session_date'='2026-09-09' AND c->>'qualification_event_id'='84446'))) boundary_errors FROM checks;
